en.headline: Lee Tung Street lantern walk adds weekend Mid-Autumn markets
en.dek: More than 800 lanterns are already up on the 200-metre Wan Chai stretch; themed stalls run on Saturday and Sunday this weekend and the next.
body: Lee Tung Street in Wan Chai is running a Mid-Autumn display of more than 800 lanterns along its 200-metre tree-lined mall through 19 October, the street’s management said. Lights come on at 5pm each day, with hours listed from 10am to 11pm, and lighting on Mid-Autumn night, 25 September, is scheduled to run until midnight.

Themed weekend markets are booked for 12–13 September and 19–20 September. On 25 September the street is also listing an LED fire-dragon and drum performance from 8.30pm to 9.15pm. Organisers said dates and hours may change with the weather.

The display sits a short walk from the Blue House cluster on Stone Nullah Lane, where a separate community lantern hanging continues until 14 October, lighting from 6pm to 9.30pm. Both are free to walk through. Lee Tung Street is served by Wan Chai MTR station on the Island Line.

zh.headline: 利東街中秋燈籠展加開周末市集
zh.dek: 灣仔利東街200米林蔭道掛出逾800盎燈籠至10月19日，本周末及下周末設中秋主題攤檔，中秋夜有LED火龍表演。
body: 灣仔利東街正舉辦中秋燈籠布置，沿200米林蔭大道懸掛逾800盎燈籠，展期至10月19日。街舖管理方公布開放時間為上午10時至晚上11時，每日下午5時亮燈；中秋正日9月25日亮燈至午夜。
中秋主題市集定於9月12至13日及19至20日舉行。9月25日晚上8時半至9時15分將有LED火龍舞鼓表演。主辦單位表示，開放日期及時間或因天氣改動。
利東街與石水渠街藍屋建築群相距不遠，藍屋另一組社區花燈展期至10月14日，每晚6時至9時半亮燈。兩處均可免費步行觀看。利東街可經港鐵港島紊灣仔站前往。
